text:
alex: Kicking off a warm-standby rehearsal next Tue 09:00 PT. Objective: exercise multi-region routing, verify nightly backups + partial restore, and run the restore runbook steps 1-4. Need owners for each task, and a short pre-checklist by EOD Friday.

maria: I'll own backups verification (S3 + GCS). Plan: validate latest 7 snapshots, check integrity hashes, and run a test partial restore into a sandbox project.

sandeep: I'll take multi-region routing policies and traffic shaping. Will prepare a canary route and a scripted failover sequence.

emily: Quick Q — do we want a partial DB restore (metadata only) for the rehearsal or a full restore? Full is ~3.5h and might block verification.

alex: Partial first, then escalate to full only if partial shows issues. Keep run time under 2h.

alex: Action items I'm proposing: 
- :one: Backups integrity check -> owner: maria -> due: Fri EOD
- :two: Routing canary + scripted failover -> owner: sandeep -> due: Fri EOD
- :three: Sandbox restore (partial) -> owner: jonah -> due: Mon morning (drill day prep)
- :four: Runbook dry-run (runbook steps 1-4) -> owner: emily -> due: Mon 08:00 PT
- :five: Observability check (traces/metric dashboards configured) -> owner: deploy-bot -> due: Fri EOD

maria: checklist for backups: 
- list snapshots: `aws s3 ls s3://redwood-backups/`
- verify checksum: `sha256sum backup-2026-04-14.tar.gz`
- compare against manifest in GCS: `gsutil cat gs://redwood-backups/manifests/2026-04-14.json`
I'll paste output here once done.

jonah: Sandbox restore plan: restore metadata DB only to `dr-test-sandbox` (k8s namespace `dr-rehearsal`). Will use infra snapshot TTL=24h so we don't accumulate costs.

sandeep: Router policy snippet I'll test in canary:
```
route_policy:
  primary: us-west1
  failover: eu-west1
  prefer_low_latency: true
  health_check:
    path: /_health
    interval: 10s
```
I'll run a synthetic load to validate sticky sessions and KV cache behavior.

emily: For the runbook dry-run I'll follow steps and timestamp each step. Posting the runbook snippet here so we can align: 
```
1. Confirm leader control plane healthy
2. Quiesce outbound connections
3. Trigger region routing shift (cidr-reroute)
4. Validate service-level probes and consumer-facing hash
```

alex: One more: track recurring incident patterns while we run the rehearsal — we've seen repeated slow failovers tied to: stale KV caches, expired leader leases, and partial routing table syncs. Please log any occurrences with tags `#rehearsal` and `#pattern` so we can map.

emily: Noted. Will add a short incident template for the rehearsal:
- symptom:
- suspected cause:
- cmd/log excerpt:
- mitigation attempted:
- follow-up owner/ticket:

maria: Initial backup check results (short): latest 7 snapshots present, one manifest mismatch on 2026-04-10 (missing file: chunks/part-0007). I will re-run integrity and open a ticket if still missing.

jonah: Partial restore dry-run succeeded in sandbox. Time: 38m. Post-restore smoke tests passed (tokenization, simple generate endpoint).

sandeep: Canary failover executed in staging: routing shifted to eu-west1, latency spike observed ~120ms then settled to ~30ms after KV warmup. Logged metrics to perf-dashboard.

alex: Great. Next: consolidate findings and create follow-up tickets for any blockers. Maria -> ticket for missing chunk, Sandeep -> ticket for KV warmup perf optimization, Emily -> update runbook with exact timing and rollback points.

oncall-bot: Drill scheduled: 2026-04-15T16:00:00Z. Channel created: #incidents/dr-warm-standby-1799998888. Pager duty rota will be pinged 30m before.

emily: I'll update runbook and post the dry-run checklist to the channel.

alex: Thanks team. Please mark done in thread or add a short status message when each action completes. We'll sync Mon 08:30 PT for final go/no-go. :thumbsup:
